integrity: The general identity is proved symbolically. The period-two witness is independently recomputed by the included standard-library checker; no finite experiment is used as a proof of the arbitrary-period statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns linear invasion of positive prey-only periodic orbits under the displayed normalized Ricker boundary and predator transverse derivative. It does not prove global persistence or extinction. The 2026 publisher interface exposed metadata, abstract, references, and figure captions but not the full article body in the accessible text view, leaving a residual literature-overlap risk explicitly recorded in the review.
title: Periodic prey oscillations raise the predator invasion threshold in a Ricker-refuge model
